> > Commonsense Knowledge: The private sector possesses unique knowledge, resources and leadership capabilities. | Commonsense Knowledge

> Fact From Story: Coming off from the pandemic and with the current global economic climate, it is opportune for the government to proactively drive for actionable policies and programs that focus on building the resiliency of the economy through sustainable development with greater emphasis given to addressing climate change.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Addressing climate change, external, and domestic economic headwinds is a complex endeavor.
